ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Garde-manger uses the camera to scan product barcodes, photograph receipts or your fridge, and read household invite QR codes.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Garde-manger opens your photos when you choose to import a receipt or fridge photo to extract products.
ios.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Garde-manger connects to your self-hosted server on the local network (for example http://192.168.1.20:3333) to sync your fridge and shopping list.
